study_summary.objective: Compare the transcriptome of the soil isolate BCC7051 grown on xylose or glucose in active growth and stationary phases; the BioProject itself is titled a genome sequencing project.
study_summary.experimental_design: One culture per condition (no replicates): xylose at 36 h (active growth) and 96 h (stationary), glucose at 36 h (active growth) and 72 h (stationary); HiSeq X Ten.
study_summary.main_finding: Not available: no accession-linked paper was found, so no result is reported here.

notes: Conditions were supplied by the user (2026-10-27) from the SRA experiment design descriptions; the user's SRX1124197 and SRX1124198 are SRX11241967 and SRX11241968, confirmed by the library names BCC7051_C6_36 and BCC7051_C6_72.
All four runs share one BioSample (SAMN04259795) although they are different cultures; the atlas counts them as four independent samples because the curated conditions differ.
Culture medium, temperature and pH are not stated, and each condition has a single culture, so no replicate variance can be estimated.
